definition.initialization: Firmware init_start through init_cycles, including model access, operator registration, AllocateTensors, input/output lookup and the first input copy; excludes firmware boot before init_start.
definition.invoke: Unprofiled MicroInterpreter::Invoke measured by the RV32 cycle counter.
definition.amortization: Smallest positive inference count for which additional initialization is covered by the measured mean Invoke saving; assumes the same initialized interpreter is reused.
definition.memory: Tensor arena bytes reported by arena_used_bytes, excluding firmware and external model storage.

definitions.outside_npu_busy: Unprofiled Invoke cycles minus measured NPU busy cycles; includes host dispatch, software operators, and other CPU work. CPU instructions may also execute while NPU is busy.
definitions.main_array_utilization: Conv/FC useful MACs divided by 256 and the sum of per-layer NPU busy cycles in trace firmware, consistently for both versions.
definitions.controller_waits: At most one of the seven named wait-cause fields increments per controller-active cycle. WEIGHT_START gives tail waiting priority over weight-data waiting; IA_START gives input data, bias, quantization, and output space that order. IA_WAIT is a separate state. The fields do not cover all active cycles; controller_other_cycles is the remainder. These fields overlap with independent DMA/array activity counters, and IA completion waiting can include useful arithmetic and pipeline drain.
definitions.controller_counter_source: rtl/npu/control/npu_controller.sv, util_active branch; test/model_benchmark/tb_model_benchmark.sv accumulates stable per-job counters at npu_done_fire.
definitions.vector_wait: vector_engine.stat_dma_wait increments once when any listed DMA condition is true. It includes write-data transmission and can overlap vector_compute_cycles through the independent weight-read and writeback state machines. It measures DMA-related activity or waiting, not exclusively cycles without arithmetic progress. Missing measurements are JSON null.
definitions.vector_dma_condition: state==LOAD_WAIT || wf_state==WF_WAIT || state==POOL_LOAD_WAIT || wb_state==WB_DATA || wb_state==WB_WAIT || state==SOFT_LUT_WAIT || (rd_req && !rd_granted) || (wr_req && !wr_granted) || (state==CONFIGURE && !dma_cfg_ready)
definitions.vector_counter_source: rtl/npu/conv/vector_engine.sv; independent if statements update stat_compute and stat_dma_wait.
definitions.counter_scope: Full-model timing uses perf firmware; layer-derived totals use trace firmware. The original standalone utilization logs describe sample 0; modified performance counters are averaged over both samples.
definitions.initialization: Firmware init_cycles covers target/model initialization, resolver/interpreter creation, AllocateTensors including operator preparation, and copying the input tensor. init_plus_invoke adds this interval to one Invoke; it excludes earlier firmware startup and later output checks.
definitions.target: 1000x targets use the same software-reference Invoke timings for both hardware versions.

definitions.scope: Measured cold-start accelerator-only GEMM with preformed input matrices and the shared 32-bit AXI test memory.
definitions.read_payload_floor: ceil(read_bytes/2), because this memory can return at most one 32-bit beat every two cycles.
definitions.read_transaction_service_floor: 2*read_beats+read_requests from earliest first AR to last R. Within-burst spacing is 2 cycles; between bursts it is at least 3 cycles, including the first idle response latency of 3.
definitions.write_transaction_service_floor: write_beats+2*write_requests-1 from earliest first AW to last B; one active write transaction and no data-source stalls.
definitions.duplex_floor: Maximum of read and write service lower bounds with perfect overlap, fixed measured traffic, and earliest possible first requests.
definitions.wait_interpretation: Controller data-wait cycles often occur while the external memory is delivering required bytes. Eliminating controller gaps alone cannot remove these transfers. Further gains require fewer bytes or requests, more data reuse, or a faster memory service.

npu_profile.buffer_scope: Declared main RAM payload; excludes caches, parameter tables, PE registers and control queues. INT16 output RAM is instantiated but inactive for these INT8 cases.
npu_profile.cold_start: Each case starts a fresh simulator process and resets the complete DUT; only external tensor memory is initialized.

memory.note: Read beat spacing is a testbench service limit even with NO_RANDOM_WAIT. Observed DMA outstanding counts and burst sizes are stored per case.

npu_profile.timing: Cycle 0 is the accepted calc_start rising edge; done is the first rising edge observing done_valid. Every AXI read completion and write response must precede or coincide with done. Last write-response time is reported separately. Excludes host preparation and the three-cycle completion backpressure check.

npu_conv_profile.timing: Accepted launch through done_valid, including hardware input gathering, DMA, calculation, quantization and all output write responses; no host preparation

definitions.per_case_minimum: The fastest successful measured result across the listed hardware configurations
definitions.incomplete_configuration: Only its successful cases participate; no total is computed

definitions.requests: Window descriptors accepted by ready/valid; count includes requests still awaiting a response.
definitions.response_elements: Sum of valid INT16 lanes on accepted non-error response beats.
definitions.return_span_cycles: Inclusive interval from the first accepted response beat to the last, per job.
definitions.consecutive_response_fraction: Accepted response beats immediately following another accepted beat, divided by sum(max(beats-1,0)) across jobs.
definitions.peak_outstanding: Maximum accepted descriptors without a consumed final response; limited to four.
definitions.all_active_jobs_overlap_requests: Each active job reaches at least two accepted descriptors awaiting final responses.
definitions.all_active_jobs_overlap_request_response: Each active job accepts a new request and a response in the same cycle at least once.
definitions.expected_elements: Independent convolution geometry count excludes padded spatial positions.

definitions.dw_useful_mac: One consumed valid window element supplies one depthwise MAC; depth multiplier is one. Padded spatial positions are excluded.
definitions.dw_utilization: sum(valid response elements)/(8*sum(DW busy cycles)); all 34 DW records are from trace_63. This is complete-job utilization, not utilization only while EXECUTE is active.
definitions.return_bound_scope: Each current DW MAC consumes a returned input element, without VCE image residency or reuse across taps. The four-element-per-cycle interface therefore requires ceil(E/4) cycles.
definitions.return_bound_speedup_scope: busy_over_return_bound applies only to the sum of the 34 measured DW jobs. It is not a complete-network speedup and excludes additional serialization not hidden behind the return stream.
definitions.requantization: Peak issue rate is one output per cycle. The current q_active/q_valid controller also consumes one group-activation cycle and three pipeline-tail cycles per <=16-channel output group, giving O+4*G serialized quantizer service cycles.
definitions.bounds: Independent overlapping stage constraints are combined by max, not by addition. Bounds are summed only over distinct sequential accelerator jobs.
definitions.dma_wait: vector_dma_wait includes win_busy, pending loads, writeback, arbitration and configuration waits. It overlaps MAC execution. max(0,compute+dma_wait-busy) is a lower bound on the overlap.
definitions.main_controller_waits: The reported weight-tail/weight-data and IA-data/bias/quant/output/IA-done conditions are mutually exclusive by controller state and ready-priority predicates. They can overlap work in other hardware modules.
definitions.cache_statistics: Each accepted demand word is classified by residency at acceptance, including cold requests; an in-progress prefetch fill is a miss. Hits do not assert zero queueing or response latency.
definitions.model_memory: SoC RAM_FIXED_LAT=0, 32-bit data, peak one read beat and one write beat per cycle. The current implementation and arbitration can achieve less. The common-operator memory instead returns one read beat every two cycles.
definitions.mnist_cpu_time: perf Invoke minus measured NPU busy is the interval outside NPU busy, including software and MMIO latency. Per-layer trace intervals include instrumentation and are diagnostic, not an exact decomposition of perf CPU time.
definitions.mnist_payload_floor: Sum over sequential jobs of max(ceil(actual read bytes/4),ceil(actual written bytes/4)); unchanged physical traffic and unchanged outside-busy cycles are explicit assumptions.
definitions.gemm_utilization: sum(M*N*K)/(256*sum(complete accelerator task cycles)) on the same 31 mathematical cases, including transfers and scheduling. Gemmini task timing is the retained comparison convention; its initial configuration commands are included.
definitions.gemm_resources: Both have 256 MAC cells and process shared INT8 mathematical operands, but NPU multipliers accept INT16 and Gemmini multipliers accept INT8. This utilization ratio does not normalize area or frequency.
definitions.measurement_state: All performance and hit-rate values describe the exact simulator, production source files and measurement inputs identified in this report.

# 当前窗口并行版本的吞吐与 MNIST 周期分析

本分析使用 `measurements/outstanding_final` 的 16 次硬件运行，以及 MNIST 的两次软件性能运行。
周期、命中率与源文件版本均由本次测量记录确定。完整输入路径、SHA-256、逐层数值和计算公式保存在同名 JSON。

## 1. 深度卷积的有效利用率与吞吐下界

17 个 DW 层、两个输入合计完成 1,915,936 次有效乘加，NPU busy 为 625,334 周期。
按 `有效 MAC/(8×busy)` 计算，8 PE 的有效利用率为 **38.2983%**。补零位置已排除；实际执行乘加的周期数为 239,492，每个此类周期的 8 个 PE 均执行有效乘加。

| 约束 | 34 个 DW 任务合计所需周期下界 |
| --- | ---: |
| 8 个 PE，每周期 8 次乘加 | 239,492 |
| 窗口返回，每周期 4 个有效元素 | 478,984 |
| 重新量化，每周期 1 个输出 | 241,408 |
| 重新量化，计入当前逐组启动及流水线尾部 | 310,976 |
| SoC 外部读取，每周期 4 B | 101,980 |
| SoC 写回，每周期 4 B | 60,352 |

当前每次有效 DW 乘加都消费一个窗口返回元素，因此 4 元素/周期的接口给出 50% 的长期 PE 利用率上限。所有 34 个任务中，窗口返回的下界都高于表中其他约束。重新量化只有一条流水线；每个输出通道组需要有效输出数加 4 个启动和尾部周期，仍未超过当前窗口返回下界。

**1.3055×** 是这 34 个 DW 任务的 busy 总和除以窗口返回下界，描述保持当前输入映射和接口宽度时的理想改进上限。它不用于四模型的整网倍率。
首拍至末拍返回区间合计 612,536 周期，其中 478,984 周期接受了返回数据，平均 3.1279 元素/周期；区间内有 133,552 周期未接受返回，区间外还有 12,798 个 busy 周期。空隙可能来自缓存填充、输入组占用、坐标处理及结果处理。

`vector_dma_wait` 合计 592,084 周期，其中至少 206,242 周期与乘加执行重叠。它包括窗口事务在途和写回活动，不能作为停顿周期直接从 busy 中删除，也不能与 compute 相加。

共同算子的外存读服务为每两周期 4 B。`48×48×8`、stride 2 DW 为 11,461 周期，接受时需求为 10,022 次命中和 60 次缺失，命中率 99.4049%；输入 18,432 B 只读取一次。单行填充每次 16 B，首拍延迟 3 周期、后续拍间隔 2 周期，连续行 AR 最短间隔为 9 周期。1,152 行从第一次 AR 到最后一次 R 的最短边沿距离为 10,368 周期。该填充约束已包含读服务和事务间隔，比仅按总字节数计算更强。上述时序属于共同算子存储器；SoC 采用每周期 4 B 的读服务。

## 2. MNIST 的 1000× 周期预算

当前 perf Invoke 为 **63,412 周期**，其中 NPU busy 42,345，NPU 非忙碌区间 21,067。后者包含软件执行和 MMIO 延迟。软件两样本平均 38,019,523 周期，目前为 599.56×。

1000× 要求不超过 **38,019.523 周期**，还需减少 **25,392.477 周期（40.04%）**。即使将 NPU 非忙碌区间全部消除，现有硬件时间对应 897.85×；保持这部分时间时，硬件预算只有 16,952.523 周期。

| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0，CONV_2D | 12,556 | 19.80% | 1,392 | 6,272 |

两个 Conv 合计 21,529 周期，两个 Pool 合计 5,232，两个 FC 合计 15,388，Softmax 为 196。两个 Conv 的图像窗口经过 IS 的物理 kernel 输入，`array_wait_weight_data` 分别为 9,754 和 5,116；该名称指控制器的物理操作数端口，应结合窗口展开供数分析。

第一 FC 为 `M=1,N=64,K=784`。读取量为输入 784 B、权重 50,176 B、bias 256 B、multiplier 256 B、shift 256 B，合计 **51,728 B**。4 B/周期给出 **12,932 周期**的读取下界，实测 busy 为 14,997，只高出 2,065 周期。有效 MAC 为 50,176，256 PE 的理想算术时间为 196 周期，实际阵列供数为 3,136 周期；当前任务首先受读取量限制。增加 PE 或只隐藏等待无法节省超过该读取约束允许的时间。

第二 FC 为 391 周期，824 B 读取对应 206 周期下界；Softmax 为 196 周期。因此将这两个硬件任务全部消除，也仅能减少 587 周期。当前每个 FC 调用固定执行 26 次寄存器写入和 3 次读取，Softmax 为 8 次写入和 3 次读取；至少分别需要 29 和 11 个 CPU 端口事务，另有验证、调度及指令执行。trace 的第二 FC 和 Softmax 算子区间中，NPU 非忙碌部分分别为 2,879 和 1,812 周期；这些值用于定位软件工作，不能直接代替 perf 的逐层 CPU 时间。

按每个顺序执行任务的 `max(外读字节/4,外写字节/4)` 向上取整并求和，仅外存有效数据传送就需要至少 **17,855 周期**。保持当前读取量、写入量和 NPU 非忙碌时间时，即使计算与传送完全重叠，Invoke 仍至少 **38,922 周期**。因此需要同时减少软件调用时间，并改善 Conv 窗口供数或改变大 FC 的实际外存读取量。此界还未加入不能重叠的初始化、尾部和短事务延迟。

## 3. 31 个共同 GEMM 的完整任务有效利用率

所有配置完成相同的 15,950,085 次逻辑乘加，采用 `sum(M×N×K)/(256×sum(任务周期))`。周期包括传输、调度、计算和写回；Gemmini 沿用已保存的任务计时，包含初始配置命令。

| mini_tflm_dsa | 468,131 | 13.3093% |
| sp64_acc16 | 513,838 | 12.1254% |
| sp32_acc32 | 513,902 | 12.1239% |
| sp256_acc64 | 512,935 | 12.1468% |

NPU 在四份固定配置中均为 31/31 项更快。两侧主阵列均为 16×16；NPU 内部乘法输入为 INT16，Gemmini 为 INT8，外部共同数据均为 INT8。NPU 五类主要阵列数据 RAM 为 66,496 B，加上共享窗口数据缓存为 70,592 B；窗口缓存在共同 GEMM 中不参与读取。Gemmini 的 scratchpad 与 accumulator 分别合计 80、64、320、320 KiB。上述有效利用率采用相同逻辑乘加数，面积和最高频率需要另行综合测量。

definitions.full: NPU: accepted calc_start to done. Gemmini: first timed configuration-command presentation to final completion with all memory transactions drained. Host software preparation is excluded on both sides.
definitions.launch: NPU full interval compared with the observed Gemmini first LOOP_WS/LOOP_CONV command acceptance to completion. The recorded first_launch_cycle is subtracted; no constant offset is fabricated.
definitions.missing_launch: Direct OS instruction sequences have no loop launch command. Negative or absent launch fields remain null. This does not prevent comparison using observed first AR timestamps.
definitions.first_ar: For each accelerator, complete task cycles minus its own observed first AXI AR handshake cycle. Both intervals start at the same kind of externally visible event and exclude preceding setup.
definitions.gemmini_first_ar_against_npu_full: Gemmini first-AR-to-completion compared with unchanged NPU calc_start-to-done. This removes the entire measured pre-AR interval only from Gemmini and provides a conservative sensitivity comparison favoring Gemmini.
definitions.configuration_selection: Within each hardware configuration and each timing metric, use the shortest valid observed result for the same mathematical case. Original selected and AUTO records are retained individually.
definitions.incomplete_totals: Totals are null unless all 31 shapes and every contributing timing record are available. Counts over available launch records do not fill missing OS timestamps.
definitions.outcome: npu_faster means strictly fewer measured cycles; equality is reported separately.

| Gemmini 配置 | 完整计时，NPU 更快的形状数 | 循环启动计时，NPU 更快的有效记录数 | 双方首个 AR 至完成，NPU 更快的形状数 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| sp64_acc16_dma64 | 31/31 | 30/30 | 31/31 |
| sp32_acc32_dma64 | 31/31 | 30/30 | 31/31 |
| sp256_acc64_dma64 | 31/31 | 30/30 | 31/31 |

| sp256_acc64_dma256 | 26/26 | 49/49 | 26/26 |
| sp256_acc64_dma1024 | 19/19 | 34/34 | 19/19 |

有循环启动时间戳的 203 份记录中，实测首条循环启动相对于完整计时起点的偏移为 10 周期。
缺少循环启动时间戳的 6 份记录均为 `tail17` 的直接 OS 指令序列；相应字段保持空缺。其首次 AR 时间戳完整，已计入双方首个 AR 至完成的比较。DMA256 和 DMA1024 的表内计数只包含数值、内存保持和事务排空检查通过的项目，不计算未覆盖 31 个形状的整套周期。

上述计时起点变化产生 **0 项胜负变化**。再只删除 Gemmini 首个 AR 之前的全部时间，NPU 仍保留完整 `calc_start` 至 `done`，209 份有效记录均为 NPU 更快。最小绝对差为 `tile16` 的 60 周期；最小相对差对应 `model_m9_n256_k256`，NPU 35,980 周期、Gemmini 首 AR 后 36,077 周期，相差 97 周期。
